北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天 1℃，体感 -2℃，有点冷哦，注意保暖别感冒！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and chilly at 1℃, feels like -2℃. Stay warm and don't catch a cold!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 多云 6℃，体感 2℃，风力不小，多穿件衣服哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Partly cloudy, 6℃ feels like 2℃ with some wind. Remember to dress warmly!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 多云 6℃，体感 3℃，北风微凉，记得添衣哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Partly cloudy, 6℃ feels like 3℃ with a cool breeze. Don't forget to add a layer!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天 11℃，体感 10℃。虽不冷，潮湿，带把伞吧！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy 11℃, feels like 10℃. Not cold but humid, maybe bring an umbrella!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天 13℃，体感 11℃。有点凉，别忘添衣哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy 13℃, feels like 11℃. A bit cool, remember to add a layer!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 晴天 5℃，体感 2℃。阳光虽好，气温仍低，注意保暖！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Sunny 5℃, feels like 2℃. Sunshine is nice but it's still cold, stay warm!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 晴天 5℃，体感 1℃。风有点大，注意防风保暖哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Sunny 5℃, feels like 1℃. It's a bit windy, remember to stay warm!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天 11℃，体感 9℃。空气湿润，体感稍凉，注意保暖！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy 11℃, feels like 9℃. Humid and a bit chilly, remember to stay warm!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 多云 8℃，体感 6℃。气温适中，早晚仍需注意温差。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Partly cloudy 8℃, feels like 6℃. Mild, but mind the temperature difference morning/evening.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 晴天 7℃，体感 3℃。天气干燥，记得多喝水哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Sunny 7℃, feels like 3℃. It's dry, remember to drink more water!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天 12℃，体感 11℃。微风习习，注意别着凉。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy 12℃, feels like 11℃. A gentle breeze, be careful not to catch a cold.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 晴天 -21℃，体感 -26℃！冻哭啦，全副武装出门哦！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Sunny -21℃, feels like -26℃! It's freezing, bundle up completely when heading out!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -26℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 晴天 -15℃，体感 -18℃。寒风刺骨，务必多穿！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Sunny -15℃, feels like -18℃. The wind is biting, make sure to layer up!
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -18℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 多云 14℃，体感 10℃。有风微凉，早晚注意添衣。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Partly cloudy 14℃, feels like 10℃. A bit cool with wind, add layers morning/evening.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 多云 12℃，体感 8℃。风力不小，小心着凉哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Partly cloudy 12℃, feels like 8℃. It's quite windy, be careful not to catch a cold!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 多云 4℃，体感 1℃。海风微冷，记得多穿哦！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Partly cloudy 4℃, feels like 1℃. The sea breeze is chilly, remember to dress warmly!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天 -2℃，体感 -7℃。又湿又冷，务必做好保暖！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy -2℃, feels like -7℃. Both humid and cold, make sure to stay warm!
